modalLead: Health and Inbox open reliably again after lazy-load fixes; Find settings promos and overview carousel copy are translated in nl/de/fr; Appearance summary tiles fit on one row. Docker production builds are smaller and faster — embed-only assets, non-root user, in-memory store cache, precomputed asset hashes, HTTP timeouts, optional Caddy reverse proxy, and compose resource limits.

items.text: Health view opens again — a missing }); and an undeclared searchInput in dashboard-health.js stopped the module from parsing; the loader now waits for exports after onload (dashboard-health-loader.js).
Inbox view opens again — the same toolbar syntax issue in dashboard-inbox.js blocked lazy load; dashboard-inbox-loader.js waits for registered exports.
Overview → Health handoff — overview tiles apply the health filter after openHealthView() so lazy loading does not drop the filter (dashboard-config.js).
Find settings setting promo — uses settingsSearchPromoTitle / settingsSearchPromoBody locale keys instead of missing findSettingsPromo* strings (config-setting-promos.js).
Overview carousel & breadcrumb i18n — nl/de/fr translations for new-features carousel strings; viewBreadcrumbRoot and bookmarks page-filter promo copy added where missing.
Appearance summary tiles on one row — six compact columns for config-tiles--text so Custom themes no longer wraps alone on a second row (config-view.css).
Leaner production image — the Docker image ships only the Go binary (~40% smaller); static assets come from go:embed. The container runs as user nextdash; healthcheck uses wget instead of curl.

Faster dashboard shell — parsed HTML templates are cached; bookmark/settings/pages reads stay in memory until a write or import; asset content hashes are precomputed at build time (scripts/gen-asset-hashes.go, store_read_cache.go).
HTTP server timeouts — read/write/idle limits on the Go server reduce stuck connections on small VPS hosts (main.go).

Compose resource limits & optional Caddy proxy — docker-compose.prod.yml sets a 256 MB memory cap; docker-compose.proxy.yml + deploy/Caddyfile add TLS and long-cache static serving in front of the app.
